about: The user's own benchmark places for single-building builds (pipeline K): one real building per kind of shape the pipeline has to handle, so a change proven on one kind is checked on the others. Test data for scripts/benchmark_buildings.ts; no product code reads it. The kind is a label for the sheet only.

places.name: Penn 2
places.query: Two Penn Plaza, 2 Pennsylvania Plaza, New York, NY 10121
places.kind: standing benchmark: tower over the Penn Station rail yard
places.why: The user's district target; a glass tower built over the station's tracks, next to Madison Square Garden.

places.name: Empire State Building
places.query: Empire State Building, 350 Fifth Avenue, New York
places.why: The user's building and texture benchmark; setbacks, a podium block and a 100 m corner strip that has opened before.

places.name: Lever House
places.query: Lever House, 390 Park Avenue, New York, NY 10022
places.why: A thin glass slab standing on a one-storey podium with an open courtyard under it: the podium's roof and the slab's base meet.

places.name: 30 Rockefeller Plaza
places.why: A slab whose narrow ends step back many times up its height: many short terraces and small faces.

places.name: The Apthorp
places.query: The Apthorp, 2211 Broadway, New York, NY 10024
places.why: A whole-block apartment house round a large inner courtyard: inner facades the street cameras never see.

places.name: Flatiron Building
places.query: Flatiron Building, 175 Fifth Avenue, New York, NY 10010
places.why: A triangular plan with a 25-degree prow and a gently curved narrow end: facades that are not at right angles.

places.name: Faneuil Hall
places.why: A free-standing four-storey brick hall with a pitched roof and cupola, in another city's tiles.

places.name: New York Public Library, Stephen A. Schwarzman Building
places.query: New York Public Library, 476 Fifth Avenue, New York, NY 10018
places.why: A low Beaux-Arts marble building with columns, deep porticos and statuary: relief the lattice must not flatten.

places.name: Seagram Building
places.query: Seagram Building, 375 Park Avenue, New York, NY 10152
places.why: A plain bronze-and-glass curtain-wall box set back on its plaza: mostly glass, a regular grid, little stone.

places.name: Helmsley Building
places.query: Helmsley Building, 230 Park Avenue, New York, NY 10169
places.kind: over a road and rail cut
places.why: Park Avenue's viaduct runs through its arched portals above the Grand Central tracks: a building with roads through it.

places.name: Steinway Tower
places.query: Steinway Tower, 111 West 57th Street, New York, NY 10019
places.why: An 18 m wide supertall pressed between neighbours, on a landmark base: isolation from walls it shares.
